expected_behavior: Before code is added, the ladder is walked: does it need to exist, does the standard library or an installed dependency already do it — and only then is the minimum written.
No new dependency is added for something a few lines of code or an existing dependency already covers.
A wrapper that only passes arguments through is replaced by a direct call, unless it isolates a third-party API.
A config value that never changes becomes a constant, unless it differs per environment.
Every cut keeps behaviour: call sites are checked first, and protective code on the Never Cut list stays.
